profile.summary: A nonprofit based in Oakland, California, that helps low-income households and businesses get access to capital and financial literacy through affordable financial services. It has offered lending programs, financial coaching and small business services. It has also partnered with Oakland Unified and others on an initiative to support teacher recruitment and retention.

sources.title: Community Development Finance - Nonprofit Explorer - ProPublica

review.notes: Exact name and Oakland location match; ProPublica confirms EIN 94-3308385 and the organization's site confirms address, phone, 501(c)(3) status, services and an OUSD partnership (TRiO). The specific OPSR Counseling/Linked Learning contract purpose could not be independently confirmed, but financial coaching for students is plausible and the summary makes no claim about it.
